$comment: Desk grade (store pages, Steam review API quotes, press, aggregators). NOT hands-on play; no claim of having played or listened.

package.basis: Desk only: Steam store page/appdetails, Steam review API (352 English reviews sampled, negative-heavy by design; all-language 14415/14907 positive), Steam news, Wikipedia (Metacritic 81, sales), Siliconera review and vaporlens aggregate; not played.

fun.source: desk estimate: superb aesthetic and identity, but thin decisions and a waiting-heavy late game ('end game in 2 days'); the fun eval rewards decisions/expression so it lands below Melvor (65.4) and far below Cookie Clicker (75.5) despite 97% positive.

evidence.quote: Everything on the farm is colorful, distinct, and full of character.
The pixel art is wonderful, and the animations are really nice on top of it.
The pixel art style is well-executed and fits the game's theme.

Watching your little farmers tend to their crops, harvest produce

dims.note: Two desktop platforms, good localisation, no phone/web, no controller.

learn.practice: Design for the glance: a persistent, low-attention view (bottom strip / vertical mode, Focus Mode) that rewards a two-second look; Idlever's watch screen could offer a compact always-on strip.
learn.evidence: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666510/ — 'sits at the bottom of your screen while you do other things'

learn.practice: Make the automation itself visible and cute: named little workers doing the chores on screen sells delegation better than a number.
learn.evidence: https://www.siliconera.com/review-rustys-retirement-offers-a-calming-and-simplistic-respite/ — 'Everything on the farm is colorful, distinct, and full of character.'

learn.practice: Avoid Rusty's lapse: once everything is unlocked there is only waiting; keep a named next goal past day 2.
learn.evidence: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2666510/reviews (recommendation 198830747; via store.steampowered.com/appreviews/2666510?json=1) — 'end game progression in 2 days, now im just waiting'

learn.practice: Free seasonal/crossover map drops that re-skin the familiar loop bring players back cheaply.
learn.evidence: https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamNews/GetNewsForApp/v2/?appid=2666510 — 'Rusty's Retirement x Vampire Survivors!' and 'x Balatro!' updates
